As the project continues to grow, the workload for new features has become more demanding, and I’ll admit it’s been a challenge to stay focused at times. I ask for your patience if some future updates take longer to release or include fewer features. Inspiration tends to come in waves for me, and I’m doing my best to avoid burnout so I can keep delivering quality content for the game.

In the meantime, I may also take some time to work on The Abyss, as its release deadline is getting uncomfortably close. (There’s still about four months to go, but the scope of that project is massive!)

Thank you all for your continued support and understanding. It means the world to me! 

As always I'll be waiting for your feedback and if you want to stay up to date with newest developments then visit our discord!

notes.title: Version Update 1.8
notes.content:
[b]Hello everyone![/b]

Welcome to the new year! I hope everyone’s year is off to a great start. As for me, I’ve been catching all sorts of sick ever since Christmas 〒▽〒. Because of that, I haven’t had much energy to work on the planned features from the previous post.

Instead, I’ve decided to focus on a smaller update based on your feedback! This New Year’s special post will be divided into three parts:

[olist]
[*] Changes in version 1.8
[*] Survey results for the year
[*] A look back at the game’s earlier versions to see how far we’ve come 🎉
[/olist]

Let’s dive in!

[hr][/hr]

[h1]Patch notes[/h1]

[h2]Endless Mode[/h2]

Let’s start with a request from one of you in the Steam Community forums. I intended to add this feature eventually, and since someone voiced their interest, I decided to get to work!

To enable Endless Mode, head to the revamped game settings screen:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45228567/ef9f161681d3ac590b76100466565e984e02289d.jpg[/img]

It now matches the style of other menus, which is a nice improvement. However, I may revisit it again in the future.

Once enabled, Endless Mode removes the usual 30-minute (or other) time limit.

Here’s how it works:
[list]
[*] After the predefined waves are completed, enemies will spawn in random waves. This means any enemy can appear, including those from other maps.
[*] Every minute, enemies’ health, damage, and speed will increase, and they will reward more EXP.
[*] The game continues until you’re defeated.
[/list]

You might ask, “But won’t it get boring? How can I keep getting stronger?” That brings us to our next feature!

[h2]Components[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45228567/8acca5256785d124b92b809db60b242cc2de658d.jpg[/img]

Components are available in both normal gameplay and Endless Mode. Think of them as gameplay-enhancing runes with a twist.

Here’s how they work:
[list]
[*] Components appear after you’ve leveled up and maxed out all weapons and items.
[*] Each component can enhance a specific weapon (based on its element), a character, or all equipped weapons, regardless of their element.
[/list]

There are currently two types of components:
[olist]
[*] [b]Flat Increase[/b] - These provide straightforward, fixed bonuses, similar to runes.
[*] [b]Conditional Increase[/b] - These require you to own a certain number of weapons of the same type or element. If you meet the criteria, you’ll gain significantly better buffs!
[/olist]

In the future, I plan to add more component types that go beyond simple stat boosts. Stay tuned!

[h2]Rune Menu[/h2]

Another patch brings another set of improvements to the rune screen’s UI!

Based on survey feedback, there was still some room for improvement, and I think these changes will be quite helpful.

You can now filter runes by multiple stats:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45228567/3f53808ffa7804357b09f7ec340d3b128a00da83.png[/img]

While sorting options were requested, I thought this filtering system would be equally useful. However, if sorting is still needed, please let me know!

Another interface change can be seen on the rune list itself:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45228567/9840be385241b141e11b5e9704f6b8409675a009.png[/img]

Runes no longer disappear from the list when equipped. Instead, they’ll remain visible with a small icon indicating which character is currently using them.

This makes it much easier to transfer runes between characters without navigating through multiple menus. You can even upgrade a rune for one character directly from another character’s page! If you prefer, you can also filter out equipped runes so they don’t clutter the list.

[h2]Achievements Menu[/h2]

The Achievement Gallery has received a complete overhaul:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45228567/e7ac66f2eea5ce952fc60a73a0ee7c152877f3ac.jpg[/img]

You can now filter achievements by multiple types and the maps where they can be obtained. This should make tracking your progress much easier!

Additionally, the new layout is more streamlined and consistent with the rest of the game’s interface.

As always, I’d love to hear your feedback!

[h2]Tutorials[/h2]

In response to feedback that the game’s mechanics were confusing to some, I’ve added tutorials for most menus:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45228567/11800edda8b9ee86d7b1f2a2135ca01353b1b67e.jpg[/img]

These tutorials explain the basics, as well as some less obvious options and clickable areas.

When you first launch the game, you’ll be prompted to view these tutorials. If you skip them, you can always access them later by clicking the question mark icon in the top-right corner of the screen.

[h2]Weapons and Items[/h2]

I’ve spent an absurd amount of time refactoring most of the code behind the weapon and projectile systems. The work is finally done!

While I’ve tested most of the weapons, some bugs or inconsistencies may still appear. As I mentioned in my previous post, the refactor was necessary because creating new weapons was a huge pain. With this update, the process should now be much smoother.

This change also opens the door to potential modding support in the future!

To test the new system, I’ve added one new weapon and one new item:

[list]
[*] [b]Sacred Fire[/b]: A weapon that summons pillars of flame on nearby random enemies.
[*] [b]Cursed Mask[/b]: An item that lowers your max health but increases your damage.
[/list]

[h2]CO-OP Networking[/h2]

Networking in co-op often struggles when large numbers of enemies spawn, especially with players firing numerous projectiles. To address this, I’ve worked on reducing network traffic:

[list]
[*] Players will now only see their own damage numbers, as this was a significant source of traffic.
[*] The number of packets sent to handle individual damage instances has also been reduced.
[/list]

Hopefully, these changes improve performance during co-op gameplay!

[h2]Download Size[/h2]

I’ve finally figured out how to optimize Steam updates! Starting with this version, only the changed parts of the game will be updated, resulting in smaller download sizes.

This should make frequent updates less taxing on your bandwidth. However, the overall game size may have increased slightly in the process.

[h2]Minor Changes and Bug Fixes[/h2]

[list]
[*] Fixed a bug causing Yami-no-Tokiya's ultimate to prevent joining players from attacking for the rest of the game
[*] Removed [b]Static Discharge[/b] upgrade from [b]Tornado[/b]
[*] Interaction prompts will now display keybinds instead
[*] Fixed incorrectly displayed skin price after clicking on buy
[*] Recollection will now gurantee one of the boosted characters every 10 pulls instead of a random character
[*] Added missing revive shrines to Northern Tundra
[*] Added background music to Northern Tundra
[/list]

[h1]Survey Results[/h1]

Thank you to everyone who participated in the last version’s survey, especially those who took the time to write detailed feedback. I’ve read all your responses, and you can expect to see many of your suggestions implemented soon if they haven't been already!

Here’s a summary of the survey results:
[list]
[*] [b]Overall Satisfaction[/b]: Average rating is 6/10, indicating plenty of room for improvement.
[*] [b]Game Difficulty[/b]: Most players feel the difficulty is well-balanced.
[*] [b]UI Feedback[/b]: Some users find the UI lacking; I hope the new tutorials help. Let me know how I can further improve it!
[*] [b]AI Assets[/b]: While some players are critical of AI-generated assets, many are willing to overlook it, which I deeply appreciate.
[*] [b]Updates[/b]: Players prefer faster updates, though the current pace seems acceptable.
[*] [b]More Runes[/b]: This was the most popular request!
[*] [b]Character Design[/b]: Most agree that characters feel unique, which is fantastic to hear.
[*] [b]Recollection System[/b]: Opinions are divided. I believe it’s a fair gacha mechanic, but I’m open to suggestions.
[*] [b]Story[/b]: I was surprised to learn how much interest there is in the story! Expect more narrative development in future updates, that includes revisiting character shard stories!
[*] [b]Expectations[/b]: Players want more characters, weapons, and maps. While it’s challenging as a solo dev, I’m doing my best to deliver!
[*] [b]Game Identity[/b]: Requiem For a Lost World doesn’t stand out enough compared to similar games. I hope that it can be changed in the future.
[*] [b]Events[/b]: Players support adding more themed content, which I was initially hesitant about. I’m excited to explore this idea further!
[/list]

Here are some specific requests I can address right now:
[list]
[*] [b]Map or Minimap[/b]: It’s coming! The feature existed previously but caused performance issues. I’ll revisit it soon.
[*] [b]Rune Combining[/b]: This is already in progress and should be ready for the next patch.
[*] [b]Story Mode[/b]: This is a big ask, but I will be starting my research to make it a reality at some point.
[/list]

[h1]Old Stuff[/h1]

To celebrate the end of 2024, let’s take a trip down memory lane and look at how far Requiem For a Lost World has come!

Behold the old character selection screen/main menu!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45228567/8fe088f9517e71ab15c1e8bdd7dda3cdc69c6442.png[/img]

With the new achievement screen you can now compare the old one with the brand new one!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45228567/e0faa3a842d594ebad6f2d6d24018a84506ce5c0.png[/img]

An abandoned character perk system - it got replaced with runes (●'◡'●)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45228567/9dda3febfef2633eea5357d573ef179d7cc6a252.png[/img]

And an old gameplay, to be honest it doesn't [i]look[/i] much different
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45228567/0b864545809b3ecaef683d06b604833edd144701.png[/img]

I even have a very, [i]very [/i] old build of Requiem For a Lost World (version 0.1). If anyone is interested, I can release it for nostalgia’s sake!

[h1]Afterword[/h1]

That’s it for today! Once again, I wish you and the game an amazing 2025 filled with successes and excitement!

I won’t list plans for the next version since the previous ones still apply, so…

See you next time!

notes.title: 1.7.5 - Winter is here!
notes.content:
Hello, everyone!

If you’re celebrating, Merry Christmas! If not, enjoy your totally-not-festive days, Happy New Year, and all that good stuff.

I hope I’m not too late to the party (っ °Д °;)っ. Honestly, I started panicking when other games began releasing their updates last week. Turns out, having a deadline [i]sucks[/i], and I didn’t get as much done as I’d hoped. For some reason, I spent more time fighting with Unity than actually developing. But that’s beside the point—anyway, I hope everything is good now!

With that monologue out of the way: this update was a bit rushed, so please excuse any issues I didn’t have time to find or polish out.

Now, let’s dress up and get festive for the changelog! (≧∇≦)ﾉ

[h1]New Map[/h1]

Let’s start with the most important part of the update: the frozen wasteland of the Northern Tundra!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45228567/eed64a98ce5544489679973f124c2cab6cc10e4e.jpg[/img]

I’ll leave the exploration to you! The map is roughly twice the size of Capital Outskirts, with puzzles and points of interest scattered throughout. More will be added over time.

Oh, and yes—the snow is interactive, in case you were wondering.

[h1]New Skins[/h1]

Snow alone isn’t enough to sell the winter update, so we’ve also added some skins!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45228567/53c9dd04ea8e9ffc815c710d8dfc8090f6786fe5.jpg[/img]

Winter skins are available for [b]Amelia[/b], [b]David[/b], [b]Lucy[/b], and [b]Oana[/b]! These are the first skins in the game, so I hope you like them~ Each one costs 50,000 gems and can be purchased in the shop.

[h1]Winter event[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45228567/8ab0a45f8b79f371dc0b1ade2b930ee222ad4022.png[/img]

For a limited time (until January 14th), players can earn rewards like runes and the free Amelia - Winter’s Joy skin!

You can claim one reward per day.

[h1]Weapons and Items[/h1]

[strike]Excuse my laziness, I wanted to record some gifs of these weapons but I don't want to set the standard for future changelogs too high[/strike] Never mind—I did it anyway (✿◡‿◡)

This update introduces [b]8 new weapons[/b] and [b]1 new item[/b], all unlockable on the new map.

[h2]Wind Maelstrom[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45228567/bb79fe4b2f0814e39917ba5ff814d9803a33e955.gif[/img]

An interesting new Wind AoE type weapon that creates a wind vortex that pulls enemies toward you. It may sound useless, but maybe you can find a clever use for it

Unlock method: [spoiler] Find an overhang on one of the mountains, climb it, and stand on the edge next to the lamp. [/spoiler]

[h2]Snowball[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45228567/bbb85e799b9d78f9b15d8e9c625074f03c2c9c42.gif[/img]

A simple Ice-type weapon—a snowball that flies in an arc. It’s not very practical, but it’s fun!

Unlock method: [spoiler] Enter the new winter map. That’s it. [/spoiler]

[h2]Gift Box[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45228567/c8b149a0f4f83f248742185274e60f89c4bde197.gif[/img]

This Fire Follow-Up weapon spawns little gifts on the ground that explode after a short delay. While active, the gifts accumulate damage dealt by other weapons to increase their explosion damage.

Unlock method: [spoiler] Defeat the final boss of the winter map. [/spoiler]

[h2]Comet[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45228567/beb25985b5d253aa0e24d0cd91fb6ae8a091f62e.gif[/img]

Comet is a new Cosmic Follow-Up type weapon. Don't worry guys, I heard your cries about the meteors - so here is another one to clutter your screen! Whenever an elemental reaction is triggered the comet will be sent down at the location of that reaction. Sick!

Unlock method: [spoiler] Enter the floating island on the Northern Tundra via the teleport in the crater below it. [/spoiler]

[h2]Flame Purge[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45228567/884cb528c1082b8a1ec61e7c7025aee39b66cf36.gif[/img]

A Fire AoE weapon that shoots a fiery beam in the direction your character is facing. I’ve wanted to add something like this for a while!

Unlock method: [spoiler] Find four pillars near the floating island and use Fire-type attacks on them until they’re fully lit. [/spoiler]

[h2]Shockwave[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45228567/6b56ea31571921a0989d7685406617e6e08bed11.gif[/img]

This Earth AoE weapon releases periodic shockwaves that deal a single instance of damage around your character. Trust me, it looks better in-game than in the gif! 😭

Unlock method: [spoiler] Near the big cavern, find a chest on top of a pillar. You’ll need to parkour your way up to it. [/spoiler]

[h2]Frost Breath[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45228567/36658956b2c2ef3d3dd3bf0214e2c0bdf8f736ff.gif[/img]

An Ice DoT weapon that releases a frosty mist in the direction your character is facing. Enemies caught in the mist are inflicted with Ice DoT. Finally, an Ice DoT weapon in the game—oops!

Unlock method: [spoiler] Find a hidden village in the mountainous area near the spawn [/spoiler]

[h2]Orbital Strike[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45228567/120b69439f45f0f03e7c9cecc56a08b86d184122.gif[/img]

This Lightning AoE weapon works similarly to Summer’s Arrow Rain, prioritizing enemies with higher health.

Unlock method: [spoiler] Locate the ruins of a temple. Within the ruins, open the chest to obtain the weapon. [/spoiler]

[h2]Black Gloves[/h2]

This new item enhances AoE-type weapons by reducing their internal damage cooldown, allowing them to deal damage more frequently.

Unlock method: [spoiler] Find a small camp on the path between the cavern and the spawn. Look for a tent or a lamp hanging from a tree, and open the chest next to the gravestone. [/spoiler]

[h1]UI stuff[/h1]

[h2]DPS display[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45228567/f6a381ee9f2a0f7c9bcd9cd57e8f3e44bc7967e8.png[/img]

You can now track your DPS in real time with a new UI component.

[h2]Menu tooltips[/h2]

Added tooltips to certain menus. Hover over UI elements to see what they do. Let me know if there are areas where additional tooltips would help!

[h2]Menu theme settigns[/h2]

Added an option to switch between the new and older main menu themes. There’s also an early beta theme available to try out for those that never got the chance to see it.

[h1]Shop stuff[/h1]

[h2]Stamina upgrade[/h2]

You can now upgrade your stamina by buying the new permanent stamina upgrade!

[h1]Bug fixes and minor improvements[/h1]

[list]
[*] Fixed CO-OP enemy HP scaling (or rather, the lack of it).
[*] Removed the flat lifetime increase from Amelia’s passive buff. It caused issues with some weapons, giving them permanent uptime.
[*] Enemies now scale with the number of players currently alive, making it easier to revive teammates.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused the game to freeze when using Tornado with only one enemy on the field. (This freeze was reported way back in 1.7.3—I finally found the cause!)
[/list]

[h1]Future plans[/h1]

Hey, it’s post-changelog dev here with some spoilers for upcoming content and whatnot! (●'◡'●)
Here’s what might be coming in version 1.8!

I have big plans, so I can’t promise everything will make it into the final build. I don’t want to give myself a strict deadline again! (ノ｀Д)ノ

[*] Streamlining the Weapon Creation Process
This one doesn’t directly concern you as players, but adding weapons with my current workflow is a pain and takes far more time than it should. I want to make this process easier for myself in the future. However, this might take some development time away from features you can actually play with, so let me know what you think!

[*] Possibly Another New Map
I’ve bought some assets to experiment with. I can’t promise a new map just yet since I’m not sure how or if these assets will work, but if they do, I’ll try to put one together.

[*] Login Rewards
Nothing too big! I don’t want to force anyone to play the game daily, but I’d like to give something back to those who return every now and then.

[*] Elemental Build-Ups
I recently picked up ZZZ, and their anomaly build-up mechanic really grew on me. I’d like to implement something similar as a meta-progression system for current and future characters, ideally synergizing with niche playstyles like DoT or pure elemental reactions. You know, actually use the elemental part of the game.

[*] New Character
This character was teased on Twitter ages ago, and I still haven’t gotten around to completing them. I guess now is as good a time as any!

[*] Custom Difficulties
This could involve a game settings screen rework, but I think it would be fun to let players tweak the game to their liking.


As you can see, there are big plans but limited time. Knowing myself, I’ll probably go off on a side quest and work on something completely unplanned! (●'◡'●)

Let me know which of these ideas you’re most excited about! How’s the current content treating you? As always, I encourage you to fill out the survey available in the game’s main menu!

I'm a bit scared to have big down times between updates, it's easy for active players to lose interest especially with a small community like this one, anyway!

I also post early screenshots of new stuff on Discord as it’s being developed, so feel free to join if you’re interested or to chat with me or the others!

Until next time!

notes.title: Version Update 1.7.4
notes.content:
[b]Hello everyone![/b]

Good news! I've managed to get some work done quicker than expected, so I thought I’d release this version ahead of schedule to give myself more time to work on the next update!

I received some additional feedback during 1.7.3, and for that, I’d like to thank everyone involved!
More on the feedback and future updates at the end of this broadcast~ (≧∇≦)ﾉ

Let’s dive into the changes!

[h1]Rune System[/h1]

I started fiddling with the runes in the last update, but I realized it needs far more work than what I could quickly throw together, so I came up with this:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45228567/ae4a1d5009972e031dae83196e7639092fbcc052.jpg[/img]

This is a pretty significant UI and functional change, so let’s talk about it!
First of all, I wanted to make working with runes as effortless as possible. I still feel there’s room for improvement, but I’d love to hear your feedback first.

[b]To summarize new features:[/b]
[list]
[*] Runes can now be upgraded (with a chance of being destroyed)
[*] You can now filter runes by their type, stat and rarity
[*] Rune recommendations now appear in a separate window.
[*] Quick rune discard functionality (with the same filters as above).
[*] Rune pages can now be cleared with a single button.
[*] Rune limit increased to 5000
[/list]
And now for a tour—

[h3]Rune cards[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45228567/393b4b695ee5eaf04a72df54fc52aff54c942bfa.png[/img]

Rune cards have been redesigned to better fit the overall UI aesthetic. The rune name is now slightly grayed out since it’s less critical, and the stat increase is more prominent to draw attention.

The orange bar indicates the quality of the rune—better quality means better stat increases.

Finally, we have rune reforging. This upgrades the rune to a higher rarity while rerolling its stat increase values. However, upgrading a rune risks destroying it! The displayed percentage shows the chance of a successful upgrade, which decreases with rarity and successful reforges.

[h3]Side menu[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45228567/6146ee251d537112da50b06862e2e7d477fdebab.png[/img]

I’ve added several buttons to control the side menu. They are, in order:
[olist]
[*] Filter rune list
[*] Recommended runes/auto-upgrade
[*] Mass discard runes
[*] Unequip all runes from the page
[/olist]
The screen above also showcases the new filtering options.

[h3]Rune icons[/h3]

Equipped runes are now color-coded because text alone was hard to distinguish!

[h3]Rune drops[/h3]

Players will now be rewarded with three random runes upon completing a run!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45228567/ca81dfc32c298b4edd4fab207c86bf4ffa28d1e5.jpg[/img]

This provides another source of runes for players who prefer not to engage with the recollection mechanic.

[h1]CO-OP improvements[/h1]

CO-OP was meant to be the main focus of this update. While runes ended up stealing the spotlight, the planned CO-OP improvements have been implemented!

[h3]Player Skill Synchronization[/h3]

Player ultimates are now synchronized between players, so you can finally blind each other with your abilities!
There are some limitations, though: skills like Yami-no-Tokiya’s or Amelisana’s are not fully synchronized yet.

Effects that pause enemy movement should now work correctly when triggered by a joining player.

[h3]View CO-OP Stats[/h3]

You can now view other players’ damage dealt in the summary screen. No more debates over who carried harder—you can inspect the facts yourself!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45228567/4a40ad1eb8b54cd502393fed91776083717849d2.gif[/img]

[h3]Multiplayer Notifications[/h3]

The host will now be notified when someone joins or leaves their game. There’s also a notification for picking up the tear left by a dead player—because let’s be honest, we’ve all taken a moment to guess whether we picked it up or not, right?

[h3]Bug fixes[/h3]

[list]
[*] Fixed a freeze for the host caused by players joining during the level-up screen.
[*] Fixed the game not processing the level-up screen correctly when a client leveled up in the pause menu.
[*] Players will no longer accumulate fall damage while dead or before hitting the ground at least once.
[*] In CO-OP, players will now wait for votes to synchronize to prevent random level-up skips or game freezes. (this may cause micro stutter when leveling up with no upgrades to pick)
[/list]

Additionally, I’ve made players unable to collide with each other. It served no purpose and only caused unnecessary deaths. ┌(。Д。)┐

[h1]Other improvements[/h1]

This isn't much, but it's honest work.

[h3]Dash Indicator[/h3]

When dashing, the indicator will now gray out instead of disappearing.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45228567/25bdab8bf1ad89f7910c4a3f4ca2581439f48f87.jpg[/img]

[h3]Reduction in Visual Clutter[/h3]

I’ve received some complaints about abilities covering too much of the screen. I hadn’t given it much thought before since it’s a common issue in many survivor-like games I’ve played. However, I’ve taken some steps and would love to hear your feedback.

Certain ability effects will now fade out when they are closer to the player’s camera. Should I add a configuration option for this effect?

[h3]Feedback Notification[/h3]

I want to gather user feedback via a survey after each version release.
I understand that not everyone wants to participate, but I encourage you to share your thoughts—whether positive or negative—because every voice matters.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45228567/d438fa592a0d13d22003ddd0b9b7523bc5fa0b12.jpg[/img]

After each major release, a small dot will appear next to the survey, reminding you to fill it out.

The survey may change between versions to reflect new content or remain the same to gauge whether opinions have shifted after introducing new features.

[h1]General Changes and Fixes[/h1]

[list]
[*] Fixed a mechanism responsible for spawning level bosses that could miss boss spawns in the Capital Undergrounds
[*] Fixed a wave in the Capital Undergrounds where all enemies would drop Memory Rifts
[*] Fixed the description of [b]Lightning Orb[/b]'s upgrade showing 0% cooldown reduction upon picking 'Storm Conduit (I)'
[*] Fixed graphical issue with [b]Lightning Orb[/b] projectile
[*] Changed [b]Fire Ring[/b] weapon's scaling. It will no longer produce more projectiles with duplication effects. Instead each duplication will increase the ring's duration by a 100%
[*] Fixed Chitose's skill allowing her to pass through walls
[*] Fixed [b]Full Page[/b] achievement triggering when players attempted to insert rune into already full path
[*] Reduced [b]Brute's Talisman[/b]'s crit rate 10% → 8% and crit damage 15% → 10%
[*] Lowered recollection characters drop rate: Other character - 30% → 20%. At least one character is guranteed to drop every 10 pulls
[*] Lowered the cost of recollection pulls from 350 gems to 300
[*] Increased gems returned when pulling a character that's already maxed out from 200 to 300 gems
[*] Lowered the conversion rate of gold to gems from 350 to 300 gems
[*] Lowered the price of character fragments from 180 to 150 gems
[*] Reduced the amount of life steal each rune can provide (1%, 2%, 4%, 6%, 10%) → (0.05%, 0.2%, 0.7%, 1.5%, 3%)
[*] Increased life steal effectivness of physical attacks by 100%
[*] Reduced life steal effectivness of AoE and DoT attacks by 75% and 50% respectively
[*] Fixed a bug that caused Yami-no-Tokiya's flowers to not deal damage upon exploding
[*] Tweaked difficulty settings to reflect rune changes
[/list]

[h1]Future Plans and afterword[/h1]

It’s that time of the year!
I was late for Halloween, but I’m just in time for Christmas! I’d love to try a Christmas event, and I already have some plans in mind. It’ll be tight with less than a month left, though. (○´･д･)ﾉ

I want to share more details, but let’s not ruin the fun. [i]Wouldn’t it be exciting to have a snow map?[/i] (｡･∀･)ﾉﾞ

Either way, expect more weapons and stuff in the next update. This one might not be as big as the last, but hopefully, it’s enough to tide you over until the [i]1.7.5 Christmas Update™[/i].

Take care!

notes.title: Version Update 1.7.3
notes.content:
[b]Hi everyone![/b]

I’ve got some great news to share—an update for Requiem For a Lost World is now live and ready for you to explore!
Tonight, I’ll be your host, walking you through all the exciting changes, big and small (≧∇≦)ﾉ.
(This is going to be a long one, so buckle up!)

Development went pretty smoothly this time, so without further ado, let’s dive into the ✨changelog✨!

[h1]New characters[/h1]

Version 1.7.3 introduces [b]three new playable characters[/b]! You might already know one of them from a previous announcement. If not, no worries—I’ll reintroduce them here. Let’s meet the new additions:

[h2]Rederith[/h2]

An enigmatic warrior with deep ties to The Abyss of the North. Not much is known about him aside from sightings of other Abyss delvers and a few wanted posters around the Capital. One is certain, only the most dangerous beings are able to survive in the harsh environment - and he - is no exception.

Rederith wields a life draining katana called [i]Blood Dept[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45228567/2a0ec4184999e27b5c4b0c3d946218ea0e9e0ff2.gif[/img]

[list]
[*] Each hit with Blood Debt sacrifices a portion of Rederith’s max health to boost its damage. But don’t worry—it can’t kill him! Instead, it synergizes perfectly with his passive ability.
[*] Rederith cannot gain Crit Rate or Crit Damage through normal means. Instead, his missing health converts into strength, scaling both Crit Rate and Crit Damage based on how low his health is.
[*] He excels against enemies with different resistances thanks to his rank-up abilities granting a lot of extra RES PEN.
[/list]

And now you shall [i]Witness![/i] his ultimate

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45228567/673ab159390cd38b213a05a9e48ef37e43a5b659.gif[/img]

While channeling his ultimate, Rederith freezes time, stopping all enemy movement, stage timers, and weapon attacks before unleashing a devastating series of slashes.

For a deeper dive into Rederith’s design, check out his dedicated post!

[h2]Madra[/h2]

A dignified priestess and administrator of the Capital’s archives, Madra rose from humble beginnings as an orphan to a life of luxury. Known for her adept handling of demons and spirits, she has one persistent annoyance: her foster sister, Mucha.

Madra provides support with her signature weapon, [i]Madra's Blessing[/i]:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45228567/0786f4e9d7ed12129f8aa81bc63f2837ae6d6963.gif[/img]

[list]
[*] [i]Madra’s Blessing[/i] generates a field that boosts RES PEN for allies within its radius, making her a great support in co-op play.
[*] As a support-oriented character, Madra can choose a damage-dealing weapon at the start of the game.
[/list]

Experience as the [i]Stars Align[/i] with her ultimate

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45228567/e6ca9b348d7ff6819f5d57ef729594749b1d2cd1.gif[/img]

[list]
[*] [i]Stars Align[/i] heals Madra and her allies while granting EXP equal to 50% of the amount needed for the next level, shared among the entire team.
[*] When paired with Mucha, her passive allows her to redirect a portion of incoming damage to Mucha through their Unison state.
[/list]

[hr][/hr]

I’d like to talk a bit about her design. I wanted to create a character tailored for co-op play—a character focused on providing support rather than dealing massive damage herself. That doesn’t mean she can’t deal damage; she still needs to perform well when playing solo. However, the main focus this time was on her co-op performance.

It turned out to be challenging to implement without making her either underpowered or overpowered. In the end, I decided that RES PEN is one of the stats that’s always useful as a bonus but won’t push damage output too far. She also enables characters without built-in RES PEN to cleave through resistant enemies!

To further enhance her supportive role, she scales off the EXP increase stat, allowing her to accumulate more EXP for her team while also boosting her own damage.

[h2]Mucha[/h2]

Mucha’s life began in hardship, abandoned by her parents and forced to survive on the streets. After enduring years of abuse, her fate changed when she was adopted into Madra’s family. While she has no love for shrine duties, she remains close to her sister.

Mucha specializes in DoT (Damage over Time) mechanics with her weapon, [i]Orb of Corruption[/i]:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45228567/9c83e6c63b2956b684d185c18e9c889997320100.gif[/img]

[list]
[*] The orb inflicts cosmic DoT in a massive area, though it affects only a limited number of enemies and can summon only one orb at a time.
[/list]

The [i]Path of Pain[/i] she had walked manifests as her ultimate

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45228567/44e2c1df32cff1a7a5e1db1efa64aaee02a725f2.gif[/img]

[list]
[*] Surrounding herself in butterflies she transforms all of DoT type attacks into instant damage.
[*] When paired with Madra, her passive extends the duration of DoT effects by 50%.
[/list]

[hr][/hr]

Mucha isn’t strictly a co-op-oriented character, but she can easily benefit from buffs provided by Madra. Until now, we’ve only had one DoT-oriented character—Natalie. So, I had to figure out a way to make a new one that stands out. To be honest, there isn’t much you can do with DoT that Natalie hasn’t already done... BUT! We don’t have a DoT character that scales with crit, and this is where Mucha shines. Think of her as more of a hybrid character. You can still build her as a traditional DoT DPS, but she can perform just as well—or even better—with crit-oriented builds!

[i]Madra and Mucha were created in memory of my beloved dogs, and I hope they’ll become a cherished part of your experience with the game.
[/i]

[h1]New stuff that are not characters[/h1]

[h2]Aura of Affinity[/h2]

A support weapon that adapts to your build, buffing a single element based on the element most prevalent in your inventory. In co-op, the owner decides which element gets boosted.
Unlock condition: [spoiler]Apply corresponding element to each stone in the Capital Outskirts[/spoiler]

[h2]Runes[/h2]
[h3]New runes[/h3]
I've added a couple new runes that are obtainable in game:
[list]
[*] Rune of Evasion - boosts dodge chance
[*] Rune of the Titan - increases size of every attack 
[*] Rune of Renewal - reduces ultimate cooldown
[/list]
[h3]Quality of life[/h3]
I must admit, runes haven’t received as much attention from me compared to other aspects of the game. However, I’m steadily working on improving the experience of working with them. This update marks just one milestone toward making this feature much easier and less tedious to use.

[b]Rune recommendations[/b] - Each character will now have a set of runes recommended for it (curated by yours truly). Of course, feel free to experiment with your own builds!
The neat feature of rune recommendations is that you can automatically equip them!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45228567/e866f0282a3bd615aea6981e6f20ee8e6661fcd5.gif[/img]

The game will try to find the best runes that fit the recommended build. It will not replace your already equipped runes, though.

[b]Automatic rune upgrade[/b] - If you have some runes already equipped but later obtain better versions of them, you previously had to manually check which one was better, unequip the old one, and equip the new one—ridiculous. From now on, you can use the option on any rune page to automatically replace equipped runes with their improved versions.

[h2]Better modal menu[/h2]

The Memory Rift modal has gotten a bit of an update, and I honestly love how it turned out!
Take a look!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45228567/67e662cd31ba28eeabc033e1c23855a0afe487c3.gif[/img]

Fancy *★,°*:.☆(￣▽￣)/$:*.°★* 。

[h1]Bug fixes and changes[/h1]
[h2]Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] RES PEN can at most increase damage taken by enemies without resistances by 25% (previously no limit) - I did this so RES PEN is more occasional and not just a replacement for damage increase items
[*] All Follow-Up type weapons got a hefty 50% damage increase on every damage increasing level up
[*] Further reduced EXP gain, the point is to make EXP upgrade that you can get from shop more useful 
[*] Reduced base HP of end level bosses by a lot (●'◡'●)
[/list]

[h2]Bug fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that caused co-op host and client to de-sync their level up screen when one of players skipped the level
[*] When swapping between characters in the character selection screen the calculated stats from runes were lagging behind
[*] The main menu would sometimes get stuck in an animation or play it incorrectly
[*] Lightning chain's VFX didn't adjust to chain's length properly
[*] Boss spawning 7 minutes into Capital Outskirt's gameplay was invisible
[*] Geode Resonance granted all players armor buff when only one was hit with the wave
[*] Geode Resonance's armor buff would last forever upon being hit instead of the intended 2 seconds
[*] Blessing of Light would heal all players when only one was hit with it's burst
[*] Particle colors emitted from the ultimate icon wasn't tainted with character's theme color
[*] Particle effects around the ultimate button now correctly stop when ultimate is on cooldown
[/list]

[h1]No new Steam achievements for now[/h1]
Unfortunately, Steam imposes a limit of 100 achievements for games that aren’t widely popular—like Requiem for a Lost World. It turns out we’ve hit that limit with Rederith, which means there’s currently no room for Steam achievements related to Madra, Mucha, or other weapon updates, now or in the future.

Unless we make it big, I suppose... ┗( T﹏T )┛

[hr][/hr]

That's it for the 1.7.3 changes!

I hope this update further enhances your experience with Requiem For a Lost World.
Some of these changes wouldn’t have made it into this version without the feedback form submissions, which helped me draw important conclusions!

[b]If you’ve gotten the hang of the game, I’d love for you to fill out the survey to share your satisfaction with the game. You can access it from the main menu—it’ll only take a couple of minutes![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45228567/acc8a1033c252bc00781fa9bc96d5e6a1eda1625.png[/img]

Or, if you prefer, feel free to share your thoughts via Steam discussions!

The next update likely won’t introduce any new characters. Instead, I’ll focus on bringing character ultimates into CO-OP mode, as they currently don’t sync between players, and this has been on my to-do list for far too long.

As always, thank you for your support—I’d love to hear your thoughts!

notes.title: 1.7.2.1 - CO-OP Hotfix
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

It’s come to my attention that there are some serious issues with CO-OP in the recent version of the game — don’t worry, I think I’ve fixed everything! (●'◡'●)

Here’s a list of the known issues addressed in this patch: 
[list]
[*] Players joining the game would not receive damage.
[*] When one player leveled up and ran out of upgrade options, the game would freeze, waiting for them to make a selection. 
[*] Leaving the game as a client would cause issues with some game mechanics for the host
[*] Clients could not reconnect to the host’s game, and in some cases, both players had to restart to connect again.
[*] Damage-over-time (DoT) attacks could crit without the player owning an item that allowed for it.
[/list]

These bugs were pretty serious, so I had to push this update ASAP — which, unfortunately, means no Rederith yet. T^T

It’s not all bug fixes, though! I had to push these changes without extensive testing, so fingers crossed that everything works smoothly.

[list]
[*] [b]Character Selection[/b]: Players can now select characters through a list:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45228567/58a9d5ec30310aa83a787fbe4dd17c6419711c56.png[/img]
The UI will be further improved in future updates.

[*] [b]Status Buff Display[/b]: Active stat buffs will now be displayed on the status bar with icons. I have plans to add timers to these icons, but we’ll see how that goes.
[/list]

[hr][/hr]

As always, I would love to hear your thoughts!

notes.title: Rederith - Character Teaser
notes.content:
Hello!

I would like to update you all on upcoming features of version 1.7.3. 
I also missed the changelog post for 1.7.2 I'm sorry (っ °Д °;)っ

Anyway, as mentioned in previous announcement I'll be focusing on implementing a few new characters and I hope to squeeze them in the next patch. So far one is nearly complete, and we will take a look at him right now!

[b]Meet Rederith[/b] - an enigmatic warrior with deep ties to The Abyss of the North. Not much is known about him aside from sightings of other Abyss delvers and a few wanted posters around the Capital. One is certain, only the most dangerous beings are able to survive in the harsh environment - and he - is no exception.

Rederith wields a life draining katana called [i]Blood Dept[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45228567/2a0ec4184999e27b5c4b0c3d946218ea0e9e0ff2.gif[/img]

Each hit of this weapon drains a percentage of his max health to boost its own damage - don't worry tho, it cannot kill him~ In fact it's quite handy for his passive!

Rederith cannot gain Crit Rate nor Crit Damage via normal means. Instead, he converts his missing health into strength - boosting both depending on his health loss. Thanks to his rank-ups he's also great for dealing with enemies of various resistances.

And now you shall [i]Witness![/i] his ultimate

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45228567/673ab159390cd38b213a05a9e48ef37e43a5b659.gif[/img]

He pauses all stage timers, enemy movements and weapon attacks while channeling his ultimate before unleashing a series of slashes dealing a few rapid instances of physical damage to every enemy on the field.

[hr][/hr]

Now that he's been presented properly, I would like to give a little insight on his development. 

I wanted to make him a special character serving both as a thank you to the person I borrowed the name from and as a teaser for the new game map/lore region of Requiem For a Lost World. 
So, how would I make a character feel fresh in the current economy? I went through a few iterations of his kit, focusing more on movement, but it was just another variation of move = more damage, and we have that on a lesser scale with Chitose already. 
Then I thought that hey, characters that hurt themselves are quite edgy and scary, so maybe that would fit- But we already have characters that work with HP manipulation such as David and Nishi.
Well, we don't have a glass cannon character yet, so let's try that! I also wanted to avoid the typical crit build on a DPS character to open more build variation for items that normally would get less attention. 
And to top it all off ultimate needed to be something flashy and powerful!

That's basically the design thoughts behind him!

[hr][/hr]

I would also like to shine some light on upcoming changes that are still being worked on:
[list]
[*] Status bar will display all buffs present on the character - right now it does not display simple stat buffs
[*] Simplified character selection screen - current one is pretty, but the more characters there are, the more tedious it becomes to select the one you want to play
[*] Difficulty rebalancing - I tried to balance out the EXP gain in 1.7.2, but I don't think it changed a whole lot, so I'm still working on it. Balancing is a [i]very[/i] touchy subject o(一︿一+)o
[*] And of course some bug fixes that I find along the way
[/list]

[hr][/hr]

That's it for today, I don't yet have an ETA for version 1.7.3, it could be somewhere around next week if I decide to ship Rederith alone, but I would like to get at least one more character out in this version, and she's being worked on alongside her partner character so... 2 in 1 deal.

Let me know what you think and thank you for continuous support!
